summary: ScoutMePlay Session 144 — Guest-first upload + redesigned /login /signup pages + Emergent Google auth bridge. Backend pytest 8/8 pass (signup password rules 8+upper+digit, weak-password 400, google/session bogus 401 & empty 400/422, Google-only account login guard, admin regression, full guest chunked-upload cycle POST init->chunk->complete works with NO auth header and returns temp_token). Frontend: /login and /signup render the new design with all requested data-testid elements (headline, card, form, email, password, remember me, forgot link, submit, google btn, benefits strip, trusted badge, hero image, password rules). Submit button toggles disabled↔enabled correctly based on rules (empty/weak → disabled, Test1234 → enabled). Full signup E2E from /signup with fresh email + Test1234 navigates to /upload. Login E2E for free@elitescout.com/Free@2026 navigates to /dashboard. Continue-with-Google button on /login redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=... with correct prefix. GUEST FLOW verified end-to-end at the network level: /upload loads for an unauthenticated visitor with no redirect to /login, upload form and file input are present, dropping a video triggers /api/me/chunked-upload/init → /chunk → /complete all sent WITHOUT an Authorization header (guest uid='guest' path). Regression: logged-in testfree-mar@elitescout.com sees eligibility-prepaid pill on /upload, no guest pill. AccountGateModal with player-marker required (MarkerStudio canvas tap) was NOT exercised because it requires interactive canvas gestures — reported as partial.

ui_bugs.issue: Expected data-testid="guest-upload-pill" is NOT present in the DOM for unauthenticated visitors — no visible guest indicator on /upload. Loading & background upload work fine, but the user-visible 'guest' pill mentioned in the spec is missing.

Rule <li> rows do not appear to change className/color when a rule is met (all three <li> keep the same 'flex items-center gap-2.5' class regardless of input). Submit-button disabled/enabled state IS driven correctly (works functionally), but the visual green-tick affordance requested in the spec is likely not applied — please verify Signup.jsx rule row rendering.

Headline text renders as one concatenated string ('WELCOME BACKCONTINUE YOUR FOOTBALL JOURNEY' / 'DISCOVER YOURTRUE FOOTBALL LEVEL') in textContent — likely a missing space or
between the two lines. Visually looks fine on screenshot but a11y/text extraction is broken.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking upload-submit-btn as a guest before marking a player did NOT produce a detectable toast in the DOM (checked [role=alert], [class*=toast]) and did not open the account-gate-modal — behavior is safe (no crash, no redirect to /login) but the 'Please mark your player' feedback could not be verified via automation. Manual check recommended.

action_items: Add data-testid="guest-upload-pill" (or equivalent visible guest indicator) on /upload when user is not authenticated.
Verify Signup.jsx password-rule <li> rows apply a green/checked class when each rule is met — currently className is identical regardless of state.
Fix headline text concatenation on /login and /signup (add whitespace between the two lines so screen-reader text isn't 'WELCOME BACKCONTINUE ...').
Manually confirm the toast 'Please mark your player' fires when a guest clicks Start analysis with a file but no marker (automation could not detect it).
critical_code_review_comments: chunked_upload.py correctly falls back to uid='guest' when no user is authenticated — verified end-to-end via network trace and pytest.
Signup accepts Test1234 (8+upper+digit) but not Test12 nor test1234 — password policy matches spec.
/api/auth/google/session returns 401 for bogus session_id and 422 for empty — acceptable (empty is caught by Pydantic before reaching the endpoint).
Google-only account (password_hash=None) login guard returns 401 with a 'This account uses Google sign-in' style message as expected.

UploadPage.jsx is 1327 lines — approaching the >700-line threshold and would benefit from being split (guest-gate wiring, marker studio integration, background upload state machine, eligibility banner) — refactor recommended but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested pages render, all critical flows pass; guest-pill testid missing and marker-studio gate not exercised)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable signup accounts of the form iter63_<hex>@elitescout.com for the signup E2E and password-rule pytest cases (throwaway).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and all frontend structural + happy-path flows are green. The remaining gaps are: (1) guest-upload-pill testid not implemented, (2) signup password-rule row visual state doesn't change with input, (3) auth headline text concatenation, (4) the full guest marker→AccountGateModal→signup-in-modal→analysis-starts flow could not be automated because MarkerStudio requires canvas gestures. If MarkerStudio gains a testable path (e.g. programmatic setBoundingBox for tests), retest the modal path. For quick manual verification: open /upload in incognito, choose /tmp/tiny.mp4, click Start analysis → toast should say 'Please mark your player'. Then mark a player + fill details → clicking Start analysis should open [data-testid=account-gate-modal].
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional regression. Only cosmetic/spec-alignment gaps documented as action items.
